text:
Total cost of college (loans): 4 years × $50,000/year = $200,000  
Lost income while in school: 4 years × $25,000/year = $100,000  
Total amount to earn: $200,000 + $100,000 = $300,000  

New annual income: 3 × $25,000 = $75,000/year  

Time to earn this amount: $300,000 / $75,000/year = 4 years  

ANSWER: 4
